title: Are We Just Applying LLMs? What SE Research Studies, Underexplores, and Could Do Next in the LLM Era
title_zh: 我们只是在应用大语言模型吗？LLM时代下软件工程研究已研究、未探索与未来可为之事

paragraphs.en: 普查4790篇论文显示AI正重组软件工程研究议程，但质疑范式的论文仅占4.3%。 Is AI taking over software engineering research? By 2025, AI appeared in more than half of the research-track papers at ICSE, FSE, and ASE. Yet ubiquity alone cannot show whether AI expanded the publication portfolio, displaced other work, or redirected the intellectual agenda. We investigate this shift through a census of 4,790 research papers (three SE conferences; 2018--2026) and free-form responses from 244 SE researchers discussing the future of the SE research community (ICSE 2026 FoSE survey). We found that while AI is taking over, it is not simply replacing non-AI research; it is unevenly reorganizing SE research around its capabilities. AI accounted for 93.1% of publication growth, but expansion in some venues and problem areas concealed contraction in others. The LLM wave also changed the field's tools more than its problem boundaries: 92.6% of LLM-wave AI papers revisit established SE problems, while most new problems arise from the introduction of LLMs in the SE process themselves. Engagement with AI remains predominantly downstream: 95.7% of AI papers apply AI or evaluate and support its use, while only 4.3% interrogate the paradigm or develop alternatives. The FoSE survey reveals a similar imbalance between recognition and response. AI-driven change was the second-most frequent concern about the field's future 20.2%, yet only 7.0% of responses mentioned AI when researchers were asked to identify one change the community should make. Together, our findings reveal a field reorganizing an inherited agenda around AI faster than it is questioning that reorganization. We discuss how SE can respond by building cumulatively across technological waves, strengthening evaluation and assurance, developing SE-native foundations, and studying software engineering in an AI-transformed world.
paragraphs.zh: 普查4790篇论文显示，AI正在重组软件工程的研究议程，但质疑该范式的论文仅占4.3%。AI是否正在接管软件工程研究？ 到2025年，AI已出现在ICSE、FSE和ASE研究轨道论文的一半以上。 然而仅凭普遍性无法说明AI是扩大了发表版图、挤占了其他工作，还是改写了学术议程。 我们通过对4790篇研究论文（三场软件工程会议；2018--2026年）以及244位软件工程研究者关于软件工程研究共同体未来的自由回答（ICSE 2026 FoSE调查）的普查来考察这一转变。 我们发现，尽管AI正在接管，但它并非简单取代非AI研究，而是围绕自身能力不均衡地重组软件工程研究。 AI占发表增长的93.1%，但某些会议和问题领域的扩张掩盖了另一些领域的收缩。 LLM浪潮对该领域工具的改变多于对其问题边界的改变：92.6%的LLM浪潮AI论文重新审视既有的软件工程问题，而大多数新问题源于在软件工程过程本身中引入LLM。 对AI的参与仍以下游为主：95.7%的AI论文是应用AI或评估和支持其使用，而只有4.3%质疑该范式或开发替代方案。 FoSE调查揭示了认可与回应之间类似的不平衡。 AI驱动的变革是该领域未来关注点中第二频繁的（20.2%），但当研究者被要求提出共同体应做出的一项变革时，只有7.0%的回答提到了AI。 综合来看，我们的发现揭示了一个围绕AI重组既有议程的速度快于质疑这种重组的领域。 我们讨论软件工程可以如何回应：在各技术浪潮上实现累积式发展、强化评估与保障、发展软件工程原生的基础，以及在AI变革的世界中研究软件工程。
